framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Code, Regulation 10 (Open Offer at 25% & 51%)

Equity market conduct and insider trading safeguards; acquirer and related parties subject to trading blackout periods during open offer window.

framework.ref: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 2(c) & 3
framework.note: Acquirer and connected persons must comply with trading blackout on target shares upon acquiring unpublished price-sensitive information.

framework.ref: Insider Threat Management & Disclosure Policy (SEBI Circular 2023)
framework.note: Acquirer must maintain confidentiality of PSIN until Form SA disclosure filed; earlier breach may attract enforcement action.
